name: myblog
description: Desktop app + CLI that manages a markdown-based learning workspace.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @myblog/core && npm run build --workspace @myblog/agent && npm run build --workspace @myblog/server && npm run build --workspace @myblog/cli && npm run build --workspace @myblog/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/agent packages/server packages/cli && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:test: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/agent/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @myblog/desktop
